title: [Bug] Anthropic API Error: Cannot Modify Thinking Blocks in Assistant Messages
body:
**Bug Description**
API Error: 400 messages.1.content.2: `thinking` or `redacted_thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message cannot be modified. These blocks must remain as they were in the original response.

Getting this all the time

**Environment Info**
- Platform: linux
- Terminal: xterm-256color
- Version: 2.1.153
- Feedback ID: 0dcdca14-cde1-424f-9874-651058a7924b
